title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Cristina Diaz Adrover and Linda Sevcikova in the W15 Antalya, Main Draw, originally scheduled for November 25, 2026 at 2:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Cristina Diaz Adrover' if Cristina Diaz Adrover advances against Linda Sevcikova.

This market will resolve to 'Linda Sevcikova' if Linda Sevcikova advances against Cristina Diaz Adrover.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by December 9, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the International Tennis Federation (ITF). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
